rows.label: Chimera Prologue
rows.note: triggered by investigating your quarters on the Orbiter

conditions: MR10 is required to build and equip Paracesis.
bonuses: The blueprint drops into your Foundry for free, no RNG, and unlocks the Ropalolyst fight.

disclosures.title: Shedu is a separate weapon
disclosures.body: Stale threads claim Paracesis is required for story progression or for the Shedu. Both are outdated: the Erra trigger moved off Paracesis in Update 27.2 (2020), and The New War hands you a temporary unranked, unmoddable one at the relevant moment.

groups.activity: crack Void Relics and sell Prime parts to Baro Ki'Teer's Ducat kiosk

rows.label: Orokin Ducats
rows.note: sell Prime parts at the kiosk

alt.text: or Prime Resurgence, at 5 Ducats per Aya

bonuses: The Ducanator on warframe.market ranks Prime parts by Ducat-per-platinum. Many 45-Ducat parts sell for 1-2 plat, so buying junk parts outright can be faster than farming them.

rows.label: Galatine
rows.note: Market blueprint 25,000 cr; build 30,000 cr, 4 Gallium, 750 Salvage, 500 Rubedo, 200 Alloy Plate

rows.label: Paracesis
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 1,000 Ducats, 1 Galatine, 5 Eidolon Shards, 15 Orokin Cells

conditions: Galatine must be a finished weapon sitting in your inventory: Forma, Orokin Catalyst, Exilus adapter and Focus lens do not carry over. Install nothing on it, and rank it to 30 first if you want its mastery.
bonuses: Rank 40 (5 Forma) adds Sentient bonus damage up to +60% plus Void damage and resistance-strip properties, worth 4,000 extra mastery on top of the normal 6,000.
